slides.title: Cost visibility per member bank and workload, with guardrails inside your own Snowflake and Azure
bullets: Snowflake usage, Azure cost data and Power BI capacity are combined in one cost model, tagged by member bank and workload. Guardrails stop runaway spend before the invoice.
Everything runs in your tenant in the EU. No data goes to non-European AI toolchains.

diagram.band: Pipelines tied to non-European AI toolchains are inventoried in the definition phase and replaced or documented with an exit plan

slides.title: Savings levers we measure against your baseline, and the controls your regulators expect
table: How it is measured or proven
Credits per workload before and after
Query and model optimisation for top spenders
EU-only processing, no foreign AI toolchain
Inventory and decision log (DORA ICT risk)
slides.note: Savings targets are set after the baseline. We do not quote % savings before measuring. AI-driven cost management example: Recordly's Virtual Data Engineer does cost and performance optimisation inside Snowflake (see team/vde); use only the facts in vde-facts.md.
